title: Kamishiro Rui — I Can't Just Lose, Can I?〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Card: I Can't Just Lose, Can I?（4★）
meta.Event: To The Gleaming Stars Halfway Through a Dream

rows.Line: Rui's Room

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Now, since our table reads have been going so smoothly, I should start working on effects and such.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: First, the scene where our hero pulls out the sword.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It's a key part of the opening sequence, so it needs to captivate and draw our audience in somehow... Not only that...

rows.Speaker: Hero
rows.Line:
“I do not know.
I am no swordsman, nor do I possess the strength to break stone.”

rows.Speaker: Hero
rows.Line: “At the same time, how long has this feeling lingered within me...?”

rows.Speaker: Hero
rows.Line: “This inexplicable compulsion to protect the world. It feels as though it has been branded into my soul...”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. I'll need to think of some things that will do Tsukasa's wonderful acting justice.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Still, him attending a workshop...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (He's always been very passionate about learning what he can about acting. Especially considering how he's been trying to get real-world experience by working as an extra and such.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (So, I had a feeling that he'd eventually want to attend one of these someday...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Tsukasa's doing everything he can to make his dream come true.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Nene and Emu also seem to have their own thoughts about it...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And I...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I'm still trying to find a way for us to all make our dreams come true together.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (However...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I may have less time than I realize...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
No...
Right now, I need to come up with ideas for our show.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Perhaps I should give this a little break...
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Oh, it's awfully quiet...
It is pretty late. The others might be asleep already.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I was hoping I could talk to someone to put my mind at ease...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But I suppose I should also get some sleep so I can get up early to continue working...
Huh? Hey, it's Rui!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, you're right. Good evening, Rui.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
MEIKO, Luka, pardon the intrusion.
I didn't realize that you two were still awake.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, Luka can't seem to fall asleep because she slept a little too much during the day.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But it was so nice during the day. I couldn't not sleep...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh, you...
Still, it did lead to us running into Rui.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Speaking of which, you came all by yourself. Did something happen?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, she's right. And you seem a little down...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It's nothing serious.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I suppose my emotions have been distracting me from focusing on my directing work.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: So, I thought coming here to talk to someone would do me some good.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Your emotions?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Actually, more like my own interests.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I see... That sounds complicated. I'll try not to pry too much.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, it really is...
Emotions are so complicated and can be so troublesome at times.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Humans have developed the ability to think logically, but are unable to fully control their emotions.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: There are even times when one becomes completely overwhelmed by them...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: If only someone else were able to help put a lid on them.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Rui...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Don't worry...
I won't be so irresponsible as to force anyone to think for me or anything.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But I do apologize for dropping this on you two so suddenly. I should head back and...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: “When someone's going through a hard time, you should take on that burden for them.”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. It's something KAITO says from time to time. Unfortunately, I'm not very good at that.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: KAITO said that...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, he has a knack for coming up with solutions for other people's problems. As a result, he tends to spend quite a lot of time thinking of what to do for them.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Conversely, he gets very anxious whenever we decide to simply look out for them from a distance.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I sometimes have to firmly remind him that getting worked up like that is only going to make Rin and Len worry.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
KAITO getting scolded?
I'm having a hard time imagining that...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: However, I understand how he feels since he wants to always see everyone smiling.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So, feel free to reach out to us whenever you like!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Although we can't completely take on your burdens, we'll be more than happy to be a shoulder to cry on, or help think of solutions!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I see. Thank you, MEIKO, Luka.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'm already feeling much better after speaking with you two.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. That's wonderful to hear.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Again, you're welcome to visit whenever you like!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, I appreciate it.
For now, I'll see you later.
